grammar.title: 说明
lines: 6 During the summer months , the monastery is very busy, for it is visited by thousands of people who cross the Pass in cars . in car s = by car 表示“使用某种交通工具”的介词短语，“by”后要直接加单数名词；“in”后的名词要有人称和数的变化。 As there are so many people about , the dogs have to be kept in a special enclosure . (With) so many people (being) about, the dogs have to be... 独立主格 keep v. confine 把....关起来 In winter , however, life at the monastery is quite different. Life 所有格 quite adv. completely 完全，截然 The temperature drops to -30° and very few people attempt to cross the Pass. to 下降到 ；by 下降了
You can go to the airport in my car . by car不能强调谁的车
We crossed the river in a boat . by boat不能强调几艘船
He was kept / confined in prison.
You shouldn't keep / confine the bird in a cage.
life on a desert island 荒岛生活
life in the army 军旅生活
life on campus 校园生活
The other side of the picture is quite the opposite . NCE3-30
He used to sleep during the day and work at night, quite unaware of the fact that he had become the ghost of Endley. NCE3-30
-30°C 摄氏度 -30°F 华氏度
minus 30 degrees Centigrade / Celsius 30 degrees Centigrade / Celsius below zero minus 30 degrees Fahrenheit 30 degrees Fahrenheit below zero
drop / fall 下降；掉落 The temperature falls to -30° ... 写作替换 Little by little the eleven minutes fell to zero. NCE3-50
plunge v.（使）突然向前倒下（跌落） The order to abandon ship was given and hundreds of people plunged into the icy water. NCE3-10 The temperature plunges to -30°... 写作替换
dive to ... 跳入水中、 突然 下降 dive into the study 钻研(跳入到学习里) dive to ten below zero 突然降到零下10度 ...
The temperature drops by 10° 下降了10度
The temperature drops to 10° 下降到10度
increase to ... 上升(稳定增加) So it'll increase to like four million per day. 这会每天增加40万双筷子的产量。
rise to ... 上升(不及物；像太阳一样自己上升) Sea water will rise to a much higher level around the Antarctic. 南极周围的海水将上升到更高的水平。
rocket to ... 暴涨(像火箭一样上升) to rocket to the stratosphere 为走红；声名大噪
soar to ... 上升(像鸟儿飞像天空) I soar to victory. 我以我翔向胜利。

sentences.title: 结论
lines: 6 The monks prefer winter to summer for they have more privacy. The dogs have greater freedom , too, for they are allowed to wander outside their enclosure . wander to walk aimlessly = roam 闲逛 The only regular visitors to the monastery in winter are parties of skiers who go there at Christmas and Easter . regular adj.规律的、定期的；n.常客、老主顾 party n.派对、政党、有同目的人(同志) These young people , who love the peace of the mountains, always receive a warm welcome at St. Bernard's monastery. 每日习语 stay off your foot 卧床休息
prefer A to B 偏爱名词 I prefer mutton to beef. 名词
prefer doing to doing 偏爱动作 I prefer standing to sitting down. 动名词
prefer A rather than B 偏爱名词 I prefer mutton rather than beef. 同上
prefer to do rather than do 偏爱动作 I prefer to stand rather than sit down. prefer后要接 to do 而rather than接 do
would rather do than do 宁愿而不宁愿(无奈选择) I 'd rather stand than sit down. 我宁愿站着也不坐着 ... people would rather pay large sums of money than have their life work destroyed by gangsters. NCE3-14
During a bullfight, a drunk suddenly wandered into the middle of the ring .
permit sb. to do 允许某人做某事（授权、准许） I permit him to do it his own way. 我允许他按自己的方式做事。
allow sb. to do 允许某人做某事(给予做某事的权力) I asked her if she would allow me to interview her, and she readily agreed. 我问她是否允许我采访她，她欣然同意了。
give sb. permission to do 允许某人做某事 Green does not give him permission to make the call. 格林不允许他打这个电话。
He is one of our restaurant's regulars .
What'll it be? 你要点什么菜？
The usual , please. 和平时一样
a party of tourists 旅行团
a search party 搜索队
a rescue party 营救队
group / bunch / crowd / band 替换词
Six hundred years ago, Sir John Hawkwood arrived in Italy with a band of soldiers and settled near Florence. NCE3-14
at + 节日 期间 On + 节日 当天
at Christmas at Easter on Christmas Day on Easter Day
on / at weekends
be welcomed 被欢迎 ..., are always warmly welcomed ... 写作替换
receive a warm welcome 被欢迎(收到一个欢迎) Let's all extend a warm welcome to our visitors. 让我们全体向来宾表示热烈的欢迎。

receive + n. 受到；得到；遭到(书面里黄金搭配) No creature has received more praise and abuse than the common garden snail. NCE3-23 receive insults 遭到侮辱 receive support 得到支持：获得他人的帮助、支持或认可。 receive adequate treatment 接受适当的治疗 receive good education 接受好的教育：指接受高质量、优良的教育。 This exhibition received a great deal of attention in the press, ... NCE3-31
